hints.title: Height is distance to the farthest leaf
hints.body: A root near the middle of the tree minimizes the maximum distance to any leaf.

hints.title: Peel leaves
hints.body: Remove all current leaves layer by layer, like finding the center of a tree.

hints.title: Last layer
hints.body: When at most two nodes remain, they are the centers and the answer.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
if n == 1: return [0]
build adjacency and degree
leaves = all nodes with degree 1
remaining = n
while remaining > 2:
    remaining -= len(leaves)
    nextLeaves = []
    for leaf in leaves:
        for neighbor in adjacency[leaf]:
            remove leaf from neighbor
            if degree[neighbor] == 1: add neighbor to nextLeaves
    leaves = nextLeaves
return sorted(leaves)
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
